mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing inactivation of norepinephrine and other monoamines; ramipril potentiates this by blocking angiotensin II-mediated sympathetic suppression, creating risk of hypertensive crisis and excessive sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if unavoidable, use lowest doses with close blood pressure monitoring and patient counseling on dietary tyramine restriction and symptom recognition.
